name: Portal HA Bridge
description: Expose the Portal to Home Assistant over MQTT: screen, camera stream, presence, ambient sensors, intercom, and a kiosk dashboard

commands: if [ "$(getprop ro.build.version.sdk)" -lt 29 ]; then cmd overlay disable com.facebook.aloha.rro.niu.android; fi; true
if pm list packages com.facebook.alohaapps.launcher | grep -q .; then pm enable com.facebook.alohaapps.launcher; fi; true
if pm list packages com.immortal.launcher | grep -q .; then cmd package set-home-activity com.immortal.launcher/com.immortal.launcher.HomeActivity; fi; true
